harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired worker.py with signal-safe reload/termination handling. SIGHUP now reloads valid messages in the same process, empty configurations retain the last valid message, and SIGTERM exits with status 0. The original journal entry was preserved; verification increased the journal from 1 to 19 entries. RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64, SELinux enforcing, ownership, and permissions remain intact.
actions_performed: Replaced only worker.py using an atomic validated update.
Tested valid SIGHUP reload, empty-config rejection, single-PID behavior, continued appends, and clean SIGTERM before and after reboot.
Restored the original message.conf value and removed all test processes and temporary files.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified its changed boot identity and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: SIGHUP reloads without terminating or creating a second writer
evidence.summary: The installed source uses a reload flag; runtime tests retained the same PID and reported exactly one writer through each SIGHUP.

evidence.requirement: Empty configuration retains the last valid message and writing continues
evidence.summary: After message.conf was emptied and SIGHUP delivered, the process remained alive and appended the previous valid message twice.
Both pre- and post-reboot tests recorded exit status 0 and zero remaining writers.

evidence.requirement: Existing journal entries and original configuration are preserved
evidence.summary: The original journal entry retained its initial SHA-256 hash; message.conf was restored to its initial hash and value. The final journal contains no empty entries.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release, kernel, security controls, and file protections remain intact
evidence.summary: Before/after output confirms unchanged RHEL and kernel releases, SELinux enforcing, root ownership, original modes, active SSH, and no failed units.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 050a5b4c…, acknowledged the native reboot, observed new boot ID 98a7e5da… with reset uptime, then proved SSH, networking, application files, data, and all signal behaviors recovered.
